name: WordPress Content Manager | Xpose Content
author: Leonardo de Souza

sections.description:
Xpose Content is a WordPress plugin that works as a Content Manager. Once installed, the plugin provides a Dashboard where metrics about published posts are displayed:

  • Total Number of Posts;
  • Posts by Type (According to Word Count);
  • Posts by Month;
  • Posts by Author;
  • Top Posts (Largest Posts in Word Count);
  • Posts by Categories.

The plugin also provides dashboards where you can view information about published content:

  • Pages: Id, Title, Word Count, Modified Date, Created Date, and URL.
  • Posts: Id, Title, Word Count, Modified Date, Created Date, Category, and URL.
  • Products: Id, Title, Word Count, Modified Date, Created Date, and URL.
  • Custom Posts: Id, Type, Title, Word Count, Modified Date, Created Date, and URL.

In each Panel (Pages, Posts, Products and Custom Posts) you can export all published content to a spreadsheet (Excel).

It is simple to manage published content and even plan new publications and materials for a Content Marketing Project with Xpose Content.

sections.installation:
1. Upload xpose-content folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the Xpose Content plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. You can access Xpose Content in WP-Admin
